gen-dafont-bushcraft-poppins: Loose, wild, widely spaced letters. Poppins counters that rope-like looseness with a sturdy, tall-bodied sans-serif, so the unmodulated, expressive Bushcraft heading gets a firm footing underneath.
gen-dafont-caffeen-manrope: Caffeen crowds its towering lowercase until the glyphs almost touch, with crossbars as heavy as the stems. And Manrope gives that tight energy somewhere to breathe, its curves opening bright and its single pen width staying friendly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-familjen-grotes: Familjen Grotesk is lively and a bit unfinished, its bowls left open on one side. Under the nearly sealed, tall Capture It heading, that looseness feels freeing, and body text around a notch smaller would sit well.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-public-sans: Capture It stands tall and commanding, its letters almost sealed shut and drawn without any calligraphic swing. Public Sans below is hefty and open, a sans-serif that carries paragraphs without strain.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-ranade: Towering lowercase, barely any openings, urban and sealed. Ranade loosens everything beside it, with its slightly stretchy weight and stroke ends set far apart, so the two feel like a shout followed by an exhale.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-stack-sans-head: Stack Sans Headline has a deep middle band and a monoline skeleton, with wide gaps that keep even tiny sizes crisp. Capture It, nearly sealed and tower-tall, gives it a tough, urban neighbour.
gen-dafont-capture-it-space-grotesk: Commanding and urban, Capture It packs its tall, nearly closed letters tight. Space Grotesk answers with hollow-reed counters and a constant-width ribbon of stroke, a geometric sans-serif that lets the heading's weight sink in.
gen-dafont-capture-it-work-sans: Commanding, urban, tall. Capture It is best at looking sealed and imposing, while Work Sans is best at staying open, with c tips that never creep together and a high mean line.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans opens wide at both ends of every s, with a large x-height. Beside the raw, big-bodied Capture Smallz, its pipe-cleaner strokes make the strongest difference: rough on top, precise below.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-karma: Trustworthy at heart, Karma finishes its terminals well clear of the stem and keeps its modulation tame, never razor thin. Capture Smallz is the raw, tactical one, big-bodied and low in contrast, while the serif does the quiet work.
